newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - KLA Instruments raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - KLA Instruments raised.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said analyst Gus Richard raised his rating on KLA Instruments Corp to buy from hold based on higher revenue assumptions and strong product momentum going forward.
-- Richard raised his fiscal third quarter earnings estimate to $0.43 a share on $155 million in sales, from $0.40 a share on $150 million in sales. The company's fiscal year ends in June.
-- He raised his fiscal 1998 estimate 13 pct to $2.21 a share, and raised calendar 1997 to $1.93 a share from $1.77.
-- Earlier this week the company reported fiscal second quarter earnings of $0.40 a share on $152 million in revenues.
